exposure: Gestational age at admission (below 28 weeks, 28-36 weeks, 37 weeks and above)
cohort: 245 obstetric patients admitted to the ICU of Sanglah General Hospital in Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia from August 1, 2013 to August 31, 2016.
finding: Out of 3089 deliveries, 245 (8%) obstetric patients were admitted to the ICU over the 3-year period, with hypertensive disorders and heart disease being the leading obstetric and non-obstetric indications, respectively.
